notes: The agenda attachment approval form is unsigned. Official June 15, 2026 Council minutes, resolution 26-129, approve the 2025 SOFI as presented: https://parksville.civicweb.net/document/82769/. This adoption evidence establishes the agenda tables were approved; the blank signature form is not represented as signed.

Employee disclosures include vacation payouts and supplemental acting pay. The source payroll reconciliation also includes 100% of City-managed joint-venture payments, whereas financial statements include the City share; the source difference is not an individual salary adjustment.
